mapper.sql: b.id as id, b.isbn as isbn, b.title as title, b.author as author, b.publisher as publisher, c.name as category_name, c.code as category_code, b.publish_year as publish_year, b.price as price, b.tags as tags, b.summary as summary, b.shelf_location as shelf_location, s.total_copies as total_copies, s.available_copies as available_copies
from book b left join category c on c.id = b.category_id left join book_stock s on s.book_id = b.id
mapper.insert: insert into book(isbn, title, author, publisher, category_id, publish_year, price, tags, summary, shelf_location, total_copies, created_at, updated_at) values(#{isbn}, #{title}, #{author}, #{publisher}, #{categoryId}, #{publishYear}, #{price}, #{tags}, #{summary}, #{shelfLocation}, #{totalCopies}, now(), now())
mapper.select:
select
where b.id in #{bid} order by b.id asc

where.if: and ( b.title like concat('%', #{q.query}, '%') or b.author like concat('%', #{q.query}, '%') or b.tags like concat('%', #{q.query}, '%') or b.publisher like concat('%', #{q.query}, '%') or b.isbn = #{q.query} )

choose.when: order by b.publish_year desc, b.id asc
order by b.publish_year asc, b.id asc
order by b.price asc, b.id asc
order by b.price desc, b.id asc

mapper.select:
select , coalesce(co.cnt, 0) as hot_score
join ( select br2.book_id as book_id, count(distinct br2.reader_id) as cnt from borrow_record br1 join borrow_record br2 on br2.reader_id = br1.reader_id and br2.book_id <> br1.book_id where br1.book_id = #{bookId} group by br2.book_id order by count(distinct br2.reader_id) desc limit #{limit} ) co on co.book_id = b.id order by coalesce(co.cnt, 0) desc, b.id asc
